_comment: ARM B — GRAPH-ONLY. Ablation role: the hybrid minus the model (C - B = what the model adds).
BLOCKED ON INPUT, not on wiring. graph-spike/compile-d.mjs#compileGraphD compiles a
routing graph from the corpus's machine-readable manifest.json -- deliberately, to
isolate the graph question from the extraction question (FINDINGS.md §2). The blind
corpus ships no manifest, and if it did, reading it would be inverting the renderer that
generated the site (CLAUDE.md hard-anchoring reference case #2).
What arm B needs is `SealedContract -> StructureModel` -- a smaller and better-specified
job than a second extractor, precisely BECAUSE the shared-ingestion control hands it a
sealed requirement set. It does not exist. ARCHITECTURE.md §9.2.
label: graph-only
